system.description: With this relic, the spirit conjurer can create a healing potion through the power of the bound spirit. The brew requires a pinch of grass, earth, water, and a drop of blood or other bodily fluid. The brew must be mixed over a flame. This brew has a divine healing effect but lasts for a limited amount of time. After the duration has expired, the brew is nothing more than a vile liquid. The potion heals 1d6 Body Points if ingested within the duration. The spirit conjurer can have a maximum of three brews at one time.
system.summary: Prepare one healing dose, to be consumed before it expires.
